title: Elden Ring And Baldurs Gate 3 Explained | Two Game Of The Year Winners | Gaming Explained
description: Elden Ring and Baldur's Gate 3 explained: who made them, how they play, their Game of the Year wins, sales milestones, Shadow of the Erdtree and the Switch 2 edition.

sections.heading: Two modern masterpieces
sections.script: Two role playing games dominated the conversation about the best games of the early twenty twenties. One is Elden Ring from FromSoftware, a vast action adventure that dares you to find your own path. The other is Baldur's Gate Three from Larian Studios, a story rich party adventure where every choice matters. Both won the top prize at The Game Awards in back to back years, Elden Ring for twenty twenty two and Baldur's Gate Three for twenty twenty three. In this explainer we cover what each game is, who made it, how it plays, how well it has sold, and what has happened since launch. We use the Wikipedia articles on both games and check sales and awards against news reports. Let us begin with the Lands Between.

sections.heading: What is Elden Ring
sections.script: Elden Ring is an action role playing game directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki, with worldbuilding provided by the American fantasy author George R R Martin. FromSoftware developed it and Bandai Namco Entertainment published it. It was released on February twenty fifth, twenty twenty two for PlayStation Four, PlayStation Five, Windows, Xbox One and Xbox Series X and S. You play a customisable character in the Lands Between who sets out to repair the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord. The studio's earlier games, including the Souls series, are known for challenge, but Elden Ring gives you a huge open world to explore, so you can leave a boss behind and come back stronger. We covered the history of the Souls series in another video on this channel, if you want the full background of the studio.

sections.heading: Why Elden Ring won so many fans
sections.script: Part of the appeal is freedom. Instead of a straight line of levels, the Lands Between is an open world full of castles, caves, dungeons and secret bosses. You can ride your spectral steed Torrent across the land, call for spirit help in battle, and try many styles, from heavy swords to magic. Those who find a fight too hard can explore elsewhere and return with better gear. Everything is optional if you want it to be, which means every player ends up with a different story of the journey. The game was also a strong seller. Reports said it sold twelve million copies within about a month of launch, twenty three million by February twenty twenty four, and over twenty five million by June twenty twenty four. It was also named Game of the Year for twenty twenty two by The Game Awards.

sections.heading: Shadow of the Erdtree and Switch Two
sections.script: Elden Ring did not end at launch. The expansion Shadow of the Erdtree came out on June twenty first, twenty twenty four, and Bandai Namco said it sold five million copies in just three days. TweakTown reported that this equalled about fifty eight percent of the publisher's total units in that quarter. More recently, Elden Ring Tarnished Edition was confirmed for Nintendo Switch Two on August twenty eighth, twenty twenty six. It had been delayed from twenty twenty five so the team could improve performance. According to Game Informer and other outlets, the edition bundles the main game with Shadow of the Erdtree and adds two new starting classes, new armour and the ability to customise Torrent.

sections.heading: What is Baldur's Gate Three
sections.script: Baldur's Gate Three is a role playing video game from Larian Studios and the third installment in the Baldur's Gate series. Its full release on Windows came on August third, twenty twenty three, with versions for PlayStation Five, macOS and Xbox Series X and S arriving later in the same year. The story begins when your party is infected with illithid parasites in their brains and must find a cure. You can play alone or with friends, building your own hero or choosing a premade origin character. The game is the work of the studio behind the Divinity Original Sin series, which also made the Divinity Original Sin games. The game is known for deep conversations, companions with their own stories, and a huge number of ways to solve each problem, from talking to sneaking to fighting.

sections.heading: How Baldur's Gate Three plays
sections.script: At its heart, Baldur's Gate Three is a party role playing game where decisions have consequences. You create a character, choose a class and background, and recruit companions who travel with you, talk to you and sometimes disagree with you. Exploration is open, and you can approach quests in different ways. When combat begins, you take your turn on a grid, choosing your moves carefully, a style fans of tabletop role playing will enjoy. Dialogue choices and dice rolls decide how conversations go, and the game remembers what you did. This design means two players can finish the same adventure with very different stories, which makes talking about your playthrough almost as much fun as playing it.

sections.heading: Awards and sales for Baldur's Gate Three
sections.script: Baldur's Gate Three won Game of the Year at The Game Awards in December twenty twenty three, according to TechRadar and SI, and it was also voted Game of the Year at the Steam Awards that year by the community. As for sales, a Larian representative confirmed ten million copies, and later the studio's chief executive Swen Vincke said it had sold about fifteen million. Bloomberg reported more than twenty million copies by December twenty twenty five. Those later numbers come from reports of executive statements, not a formal sales release, so treat them as estimates. Either way, it is one of the biggest role playing successes of recent years and proof that long, deep games still find a huge audience.

sections.heading: Two different ways to play
sections.script: So how do the two games compare? Elden Ring is an action role playing game where your reflexes, timing and patience matter. You roll, dodge and strike in real time, and the story is told through short scenes, item descriptions and the world itself. Baldur's Gate Three is built around conversation, party management and turn based battles, with a story told through long dialogue scenes and voiced companions. One rewards exploration and persistence, the other rewards curiosity and role playing. Both give the player freedom to approach problems in different ways, and both reward you for paying attention. If you enjoy one, you might be surprised how much you enjoy the other.

sections.heading: Which one should you start with
sections.script: If you like action, bosses and a feeling of triumph after a hard fight, start with Elden Ring. Begin with a class that suits you, explore the early area slowly, and do not be afraid to ride away from a boss you cannot beat. If you enjoy stories, characters, choices and long conversations, start with Baldur's Gate Three. Pick your companions with care and take your time with each decision. Both games are long, so plan for dozens of hours. You can play Elden Ring on PlayStation, Xbox and Windows, and soon on Switch Two, while Baldur's Gate Three is available on Windows, macOS, PlayStation Five and Xbox Series X and S.

sections.heading: Elden Ring or Baldur's Gate Three
sections.script: These two games showed that big, ambitious role playing experiences can win players and awards at the same time. Elden Ring turned the Souls style challenge into an open world adventure, and Baldur's Gate Three turned a classic series into a modern story with endless choices. Now we want to hear from you. Which one do you think deserved Game of the Year more, and which one would you recommend to a friend who is new to role playing games? Tell us in the comments.
